title: Indian EV startup River raises $120M Series C to scale production, launch more models
slides: River raised $120M, but can it survive India's EV race?
The startup now plans to double its production capacity.
Unlike rivals, River sells only two-wheelers, not cars.
New models will target last-mile delivery fleets next.
Watch if River's cash outlasts its competitors' burn.
thread_text:
1. River's $120M gamble

It's betting everything on two-wheelers while rivals chase cars. The production cap will double, but the road ahead is narrow.

2. The two-wheeler trap

Unlike competitors, River has no car line to fall back on. Its survival hinges on one bet alone.

3. Delivery fleets next

New models are aimed at last-mile logistics. That's a different customer, with different demands and margins.

4. Cash vs. burn

The real race is financial: can River's funds outlast rivals' spending? Every quarter tightens the math.

5. Watch the burn rate

Check River's next funding round or earnings. If cash runs out before sales scale, the bet's off. Will you track it?
